about: Hand-labelled /pick cases for scripts/eval_fill_decisions.py. Synthetic: no real applicant data. `expected` is the option text that states the fact (a list when several do; null when none does and abstaining is right). `route` defaults to slot; a low_stakes case names the setting (`low_stakes`: on/off) and has no slot or fact; a reasoned case carries a synthetic `history` of jobs and schools. `today` pins the date a reasoned case counts from. `code_path`: a check that the setting (not a model) decides; reported apart, not counted. `tag`: "reversed" marks a question asked as the reverse or a negation of its fact (owner, 2026-09-27); run them alone with --tag reversed. `tag`: "derived" marks a status, list or name fact against a Yes/No question: it is never turned into a Yes or No, so abstaining is right.
